roses:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent PNG flower bouquet sprite for a black galaxy animation, displayed at 60-180 pixels.
Primary request: One abundant rounded bouquet of golden yellow roses with natural green leaves and short stems held together by a discreet green ribbon.
Style/medium: Realistic flowers with detailed natural petals, vivid bright golden yellow, natural green foliage, strong readable silhouette.
Composition/framing: Square image. Front view from a slightly elevated angle. Entire bouquet including short stems and ribbon fully inside the frame, centered with tight margins, no cropping.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine transparent background with real alpha transparency, not a solid color or checkerboard pattern.
Constraints: Exactly one bouquet. No wrapping paper, no pot or vase, no text, no external shadows, and no other objects.
field:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: vertical 2:3 romantic background illustration for a webpage with white HTML text overlaid later.
Primary request: A lush sunflower field with a central footpath receding into the distant horizon. Large detailed golden sunflowers in the lower foreground frame the central path. The sky is a romantic sunset in magenta, purple and muted orange.
Style/medium: Detailed, polished romantic illustration with rich natural flower textures, soft luminous twilight and gentle atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: Vertical 2:3 aspect ratio. Keep the upper half spacious and mostly clear sky with smooth magenta and purple tones, sufficiently dark and visually quiet for white text. Place the horizon around the vertical midpoint and the detailed large sunflowers mainly in the lower half. The central path guides the eye into the horizon.
Constraints: Full-bleed opaque background artwork. No people, no text, no typography, no interface, no watermark.
